$comment: The one grammar of a network-policy allowlist entry. The engine's parser (engine/crates/shared/src/network_policy.rs) and the Android builder that refuses an entry at the call site (platforms/android/library/.../NetworkPolicy.java) each read this file in a test, so the two cannot disagree about what a host may write. accepted pairs an entry with the form it is stored in; every refused entry must be refused by both. builderSample is what the Android builder writes for the policy its test builds (request api.example.com, download *.cdn.example.com, socket unrestricted, plain HTTP and the local network on); the engine's test parses it, so the keys the two use cannot drift.
